Hi Sarah / Tom 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the info we need to kick off the POC trial planning:

1) Success criteria (what you said in the call):
- 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 512-token requests
- Cost target: < $0.0025 per 1k tokens for production-equivalent workload
- Model functional pass: generation quality on 5 canonical prompts (TBD by Acme)

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Workload & traffic intake, share SOW-draft and workload template (attached)
- Week 1: Baseline runs on a small sample dataset; telemetry collection
- Week 2: Tune batching/quantization profile; run scale test to target RPS
- Week 3: Final validation & handoff to your platform team

3) Workload profile details we need from you (please fill workload_profile_template.xlsx):
- Steady-state RPS (avg): e.g., 18 RPS
- Peak RPS / burst: e.g., 220 RPS sustained bursts for ~510m
- Typical request token lengths: prompt avg 120 tokens, completion avg 240 tokens (range: 401024)
- Concurrency: expected concurrent in-flight requests 4060
- Percentiles to monitor: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency and tail token cost
- Any tokenization/cleanup applied client-side? (yes/no and brief)

4) Ownership & next steps:
- Sarah: complete workload template and attach sample traffic CSV (if available)  due 2027-05-13
- Ben / Marissa: draft SOW + propose test infra and target model variants  deliver by 2027-05-14
- Dylan: sizing and estimate of dedicated capacity required for trial (initial)  by 2027-05-14

Attached: workload_profile_template.xlsx (please fill), SOW-draft.pdf (early draft).

If anything above doesn't match what you expect, flag and we can adjust.

Best,
Ben

- Tokens: prompt lengths average ~100 tokens (range 30350). Completions average ~200 tokens. We'll provide a sample of 1,000 requests exported from our proxy (anonymized).

2) On security: we'll need SOC 2 evidence and a short notes doc on data residency  I'll open a separate ticket for that.

Delivering the attachments now. Let me know if you want a short sync tomorrow to walk through the sample.
